items.summary: Recommendation: Reject the proposed wetslit.com readiness assessment and authorize no new production or queue work this cycle. Existing telemetry already covers the requested evidence; attribution is low-volume or aggregate, the revenue window is one day, operations sweeps are unavailable, and zero outcomes are proven. Continue existing measurement, failure-repair, and bounded security-gate work only. No owner decision is required.
